info.title: RosteredAI Agency Partner API
info.description:
The integration API for staffing agencies connected to RosteredAI. Receive shift requests, put
candidates forward, manage your workers, skills and compliance, read the hours your workers clocked at each client, and stay
in sync through signed webhooks.

## Authentication
OAuth 2.0 **client credentials**, issued by the RosteredAI integrations platform. Create a credential in
**Settings › Integrations** (the secret is shown once), then call `POST /user/api/integrations/token`
(form-encoded) on the platform gateway to exchange your `client_id` / `client_secret` for a bearer token,
and send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every other call. Rotating or revoking a credential, or the
agency being deactivated, stops every token it issued within about a minute. Use the **Authorize** button above to try
calls in this page.

## Conventions
- Most endpoints are **POST** and carry filters in the JSON body; a few reads are **GET** with query parameters.
- All responses (except the token endpoint) use the envelope `{ "data": …, "message": "…", "timeZone": "…" }`, where `timeZone` is the clock the times inside are on unless a row names its own.
- All bodies are **camelCase JSON**. Ids are GUIDs; a time of day is `HH:mm:ss` on an API row and `HH:mm` in a webhook payload. Every business date and time is sent on the clock someone keeps, with no zone marker: a shift or attendance time is the location's own wall clock, and a stored instant such as `expiresAt` is converted to that location's clock before it is sent. Do not add an offset or convert them. `timeZone` names the clock — on the row where the row knows its location, otherwise on the response envelope. A calendar date such as `expiryDate` is sent as a date alone. Tracking stamps stay UTC and carry a `Z`: `createdDate`, `modifiedDate`, and any field ending in `Utc`.
- Your agency is determined by your token — you never send your own `tblAgencyId`.
- Paging: `page`, `pageSize`, `search`, `sortBy`, `order`; responses wrap rows as `{ items, totalRecords, totalPages, page, pageSize }`.

## Status codes
Every operation can return the same set, and the message text is always in `message`:

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | Success. |
| `400` | The request body was missing or failed validation. |
| `401` | The bearer token is missing, malformed or expired. |
| `403` | Your token lacks the required scope. |
| `404` | The item does not exist, or is not yours. Another company's data is never returned, but some calls answer it with `403`, `400` or an empty `200` instead. |
| `409` | Blocked by a dependency or a duplicate. Only `/add-update-agency-details`, which takes `rowVersion`, also answers it when the record changed since you read it. |
| `500` | Unexpected server error; `message` carries a reference id to quote to support. |

The token endpoint is the exception: it follows OAuth 2.0 and returns `{ error, error_description }` with `400` (bad request) or `401` (invalid client). It is the only call that is rate limited today, so it is the only one that can answer `429`.

## Isolation
You only ever see your own agency’s data and what connected clients share with you. Another agency’s
id has no effect — every call is scoped to your own agency by your token.

## Webhooks
Webhook endpoints, subscriptions, test sends and the delivery log live on the integrations platform
under `/user/api/integrations/webhooks/...` (see Webhook management). The event payloads we send you
are documented as **callbacks** on *Register or update a webhook endpoint*, one for every event an agency can
subscribe to; each endpoint has its own
signing secret, shown once when the endpoint is created or its secret is rotated.

### Webhook security
Every delivery is signed. Header `X-RosteredAI-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex>`, where
`hex = HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<unix>." + rawBody)` in lowercase. Verify over the **raw** request body,
deduplicate on `eventId`, treat events as unordered, and return `2xx`. A non-2xx response (other than
`410 Gone`) is retried up to 8 times on a backoff schedule before the delivery stops; you can replay a
stopped delivery from the delivery log.

> Replace the server `host` variable with the production (or sandbox) address your RosteredAI contact provides.

TimesheetsGetAgencyTimesheetsRequest.description: Your shifts over a date range. Your agency comes from your token.

fromDate.description: First shift date to include. The shift's local date. The location's wall clock, sent with no offset; not UTC.

toDate.description: Last shift date to include (inclusive); not before fromDate. The location's wall clock, sent with no offset; not UTC.

tblTenantId.description: Narrow to one client. Omit to read every client you work for.

tblAgencyStaffId.description: Narrow to one of your workers.

timesheetStatus.description: Timesheet status: 1 Awaiting attendance (booked, nothing clocked) · 2 In progress (clocked in, not out) · 3 Completed (clocked out) · 4 No-show (nothing payable) · 5 Cancelled after the worker started (the hours worked still count). Omit for every status.

search.description: Matches the worker, client, location or role name (contains, case-insensitive).

TimesheetsAgencyTimesheet.description: One of your shifts at a client: what was rostered, what was clocked, and what it came to. Rates and amounts are GST inclusive; times are local wall-clock at the client's location, with no time zone.

tblAgencyPlacementId.description: Your booking; the placement is the timesheet.

tblTenantId.description: The client the shift was worked for.

roleName.description: The worker's primary role; null when none is recorded.

tblShiftId.description: The client's rostered shift; null on an unscheduled punch.

scheduledStart.description: Booked start; null on an unscheduled punch. The location's wall clock, sent with no offset; not UTC.

scheduledEnd.description: Booked end. The location's wall clock, sent with no offset; not UTC.

scheduledHours.description: Rostered hours, net of the rostered break.

scheduledAmount.description: What the rostered hours come to.

actualStart.description: Clocked in; null when nothing was punched. The location's wall clock, sent with no offset; not UTC.

actualEnd.description: Clocked out. The location's wall clock, sent with no offset; not UTC.

actualHours.description: Clocked hours less breaks; 0 while a clock-out is missing.

actualAmount.description: What the clocked hours come to.

payBasis.description: Which hours the client pays: 0 Actual hours (clocked in to out, less breaks; the default) · 1 Scheduled hours (the rostered window less its break)

scheduledBreakMinutes.description: The break the roster allows for.

breakMinutes.description: The break deducted from the hours charged: what was punched, or the rostered break when nothing was.

rateFrom.description: Lowest rate applied across the shift's days.

rateTo.description: Highest rate applied; equal to rateFrom unless the shift spans a rate change.

amount.description: What the shift comes to, GST inclusive.

status.description: Timesheet status: 1 Awaiting attendance (booked, nothing clocked) · 2 In progress (clocked in, not out) · 3 Completed (clocked out) · 4 No-show (nothing payable) · 5 Cancelled after the worker started (the hours worked still count)

rateSource.description: Where the rate came from: 0 None (the shift cannot be priced) · 1 Agreed on the shift · 2 Your rate card · 3 The client's default rate for you

flags.description: Bit flags, combined: 1 No attendance · 2 Missing clock-out · 4 Late arrival · 8 Early departure · 16 Overtime · 32 Break exceeded · 64 No break recorded (the rostered break was deducted) · 128 Multiple sessions (the earliest was used) · 256 Unpriced · 512 Location time zone missing · 1024 Unscheduled (clocked in with nothing rostered)

approvalStatus.description: The client's decision: 0 Pending (still counted) · 1 Approved · 2 Declined (listed, but left out of every total)

shiftCount.description: Shifts counted towards the money; declined shifts are not.

totalShiftCount.description: Every shift in the range, declined ones included.

TimesheetsAgencyTimesheetAgencyTotal.description: One agency's share of the range; for you, your own.

shiftCount.description: Shifts counted towards the money; declined shifts are not.

totalShiftCount.description: Every shift in the range, declined ones included.

TimesheetsAgencyTimesheetClientTotal.description: One client's share of the range, which is the split you bill by.

TimesheetsAgencyTimesheetTotals.description: Everything the filters matched, not just the page. Declined shifts are counted in declinedCount and left out of the money.

approvedCount.description: Approved by the client; inside the money.

awaitingApprovalCount.description: No decision yet; still inside the money.

declinedCount.description: Declined; left out of the money.

unpricedCount.description: Shifts no rate resolves for, charged at nothing.

TimesheetsAgencyTimesheetList.description: One page of shifts, newest first, with totals for the whole range.

TimesheetsAgencyTimesheetSegment.description: One calendar day of a shift, priced on its own date; an overnight shift has one per day.

date.description: The day. The location's wall clock, sent with no offset; not UTC.

start.description: Start within the day. The location's wall clock, sent with no offset; not UTC.

end.description: End within the day. The location's wall clock, sent with no offset; not UTC.

payableHours.description: Hours charged for on this day.

rateKind.description: Which rate applied: 1 Base · 2 Weekend · 3 Public holiday

holidayName.description: The public holiday the rate came from.

TimesheetsAgencyTimesheetBreak.description: One break punched on the client's device; an unfinished break deducts nothing.

start.description: Break start. The location's wall clock, sent with no offset; not UTC.

end.description: Break end; null while open. The location's wall clock, sent with no offset; not UTC.

TimesheetsAgencyTimesheetDetail.description: One shift in full: the booking, what was worked, and how the amount was arrived at.

segments.description: Per day, in order, adding up to the amount.

tblAgencyRateCardId.description: The rate card row the weekend and holiday rates came from; null when no card matched the role.

matchedRoleName.description: The role the card was matched on.

agreedRate.description: The rate agreed when the shift was offered to you, where there was one.

applyPublicHolidayRate.description: Whether this client pays you public-holiday rates.

Unauthenticated.description: Missing, malformed or expired bearer token.
